domain: Real Estate Listings and Property Attributes
scenario:
A leading real estate company is developing a sophisticated property listing and management platform. This platform will cater to property seekers, real estate agents, and property managers by providing comprehensive data on available residential units, including detailed attributes and amenities.

The system will store and manage data about each property, such as its address, rental price, and the number of bedrooms and bathrooms. It will also catalog various amenities associated with each property, such as availability of elevators, pet allowances, and in-unit laundry facilities. Users of the platform will be able to filter properties based on these amenities to find listings that meet their specific needs.

Additionally, the platform will track interest levels for each listing, helping agents prioritize their marketing efforts. The system will also support geolocation data, enabling users to search for properties within specific neighborhoods or proximity to points of interest.

The platform requires robust analytics functionalities to monitor market trends, such as average rental prices and popular amenities, to assist property owners and agents in making informed decisions. It will also need an advanced user management system to handle different roles, from casual property seekers to power users with advanced access rights.
